verdict.rationale: Mixpanel has built-in AI features, such as agents that monitor your product, so asking whether it can consume external MCP servers is a fair question. The evidence documents only Mixpanel's hosted MCP server, which exposes Mixpanel data to outside AI assistants. That is the server role, not this client story, so it earns no credit. Nothing shows Mixpanel connecting to or using tools from third-party MCP servers.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
